[spoiler=[b]Reichs-Cyberkrieg[/b]]

0300-Bobian Digital Infrastructure

Working simultaneously with the J-16CJ strike packages suppression of air defenses, the Reich Cyberverteidigung, the Kaiserreichs cyber warfare division would spring into action. Developed over the past two decades the units F3EAD doctrine would be put to the test. The core parts of the cyberattack doctrine: find, fix, finish, exploit, analyze and disseminate, would be executed by the Cyberverteidigung with extreme efficiency. 

Bobian command and control nodes, intelligence systems, logistics networks and satellite stations would be identified by combing through the stream of information being intercepted. Within Bobian SCADA/ICS systems, the Cyberverteidgung would search for any vulnerabilities: outdated software, exposed APIs, misconfigured firewalls. Bobian defense vendors and contractors would also be targeted to find cracks in the Bobian systems. 

Constant probing for weaknesses would continue at all ends of Bobian digital infrastructure. Once an issue, no matter how small had been detected, the cyberattack would begin in full. Accessing systems through the cracks would lead to the Reich quickly utilizing privilege escalation. Token impersonation, vulnerable local services and hitting poorly secured interfaces would help them move up from user to admin/root. They would move laterally too. WMI would be used to stealthily move through Bobian systems to minimize detection by counterattacks as they scoured for domain controllers and servers tied to weapons systems. 

Once the Cyberverteidigung had reached their targets they would begin to exploit everything they could get their hands on within Bobian digital infrastructure. 

Data exfiltration and manipulation would be one of these tactics. Battle plans, technical schematics, personnel rosters and surveillance data would all be extracted by the Reich to aid the Reichswehr in its ongoing conflict and to disadvantage the Bobians. At the same time to mislead and confuse the Bobians the Reichswehr would undertake data manipulation as well. False targeting coordinates would be inputted, false satellite coverage and fake fuel and inventory counts as well to damage the Bobian kill chain and logistics. 

However, the attack is just beginning. Now the cyberattacks payload would go loud. Disk wipers would completely remove information from hard drives and storage units across the Bobian infrastructure within the systems they had gained access to. Any Bobian military infrastructure that uses digital technology would likely be a target. Communications would be delayed and jamming would be widespread with cyber deployed firmware bricking. 

The cyberattack would also target the Bobian command structure itself. False alerts of ghost units and false missile launches would be delivered to Bobian commanders, confusing leadership on which attacks are real and which are fake. The purpose of this is to paralyze the command and potentially force them to waste resources as the REG-3000 missiles tear into their air defenses and hypersonics race towards their ships. The response to defend themselves too will be hampered by this all out digital attack. GPS waypoints for guided munitions would be altered and elevation data would be tampered with as well.[/spoiler]

[nation]British Republic of Bob[/nation]

This takes place at the same time as the suppression of air defenses and naval strikes start.
